From today, Runna subscribers can use the brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details below.

Runna adds training tools to cope with high temperatures

Personal running coach app Runna announced three updates today, aimed at supporting users throughout their entire training cycle, covering everything from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature launches today, helping users identify cooler times to run, and recommending adjusted pace targets based on felt-like temperature, training duration, and specific sessions.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature displays an hourly weather forecast colour-coded by the hour, allowing users to quickly identify the best times to run and schedule their training accordingly.

Here's how Runna introduced this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. Once a user launches a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K, the system automatically generates a corresponding plan. Steph Kessell, Runna's head coach and former Olympian, said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury."

Finally, the platform announced a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" set to launch in August. Users can pre-schedule multiple training plans, and the system will seamlessly transition from one plan to the next, further streamlining the long-term training process.

Here's how Runna outlined the benefits of the "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year of training in minutes: Runners can stack races, mid-term goals, and training blocks for a complete, at-a-glance overview of the year. Zero admin between plans: No rebuilding or starting from scratch—when one plan ends and the next begins, your preferred training schedule, projected finish times, and current fitness level all carry over automatically. Flexible and in control: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or removed at any time, giving runners full control of their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is expertly crafted by Runna's coaches using proven training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day readiness.
